objs.name: document
objs.description: A manageable unit in the paperless management system that can be created, edited, released, distributed and archived, encompassing policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, and work instructions.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document such as Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, or Work Instruction

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the document in its lifecycle such as editing, review, or released

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: The version identifier assigned to each released document

attributes.name: valid_until_date
attributes.description: The expiration date calculated from release date plus validity period

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which the document becomes valid

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The name or heading of the document

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: A code prefix for the document type

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: The substantive information contained within the document

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: The period for which archived documents are retained before physical deletion

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person who interacts with the system in various roles such as reader, author, reviewer, or releaser.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: The functional role assigned to the user such as Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, or Translator

attributes.name: authorization_level
attributes.description: The read and write permissions assigned to the user

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users organized together for collective authorization and distribution purposes.

attributes.name: group_name
attributes.description: The identifier for the user group

attributes.name: authorization_type
attributes.description: The type of collective authorization such as Reader, Author, or Reviewer

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document that is automatically released with the main document and triggers versioning of the main document when modified.

attributes.name: archive_status
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the attachment is archived or active

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: The version of the attachment which follows the main document versioning

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: A document supplement not subject to the release cycle of the main document and not requiring dual control approval.

attributes.name: publication_status
attributes.description: Whether the additional information is published or not

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A suggested modification to an existing document that can be created without affecting the document version or content.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The state of the change proposal such as pending or completed

attributes.name: implementation_status
attributes.description: Whether the proposal is scheduled for implementation

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A maintained set of User Groups or persons assigned to receive document release notifications and acknowledgement requests.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Either Distribution by Email or Distribution for Acknowledgement

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated request initiated 30 days before document validity expires to assess whether the document remains valid.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the validity extension request

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to invalidate a document that has no additional validity and must be withdrawn from circulation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the override request

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated document and restore its active status.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the reactivation request

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: A confirmation action by a user that they have received and reviewed a document.

attributes.name: confirmation_status
attributes.description: Whether the acknowledgement has been confirmed or is pending

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A digital signature applied by a workflow participant to document their approval or action.

attributes.name: participant_name
attributes.description: The name of the person who applied the signature

attributes.name: signature_date
attributes.description: The date and time when the signature was applied

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: A step in a process that must be completed by an assigned participant.

attributes.name: task_type
attributes.description: The nature of the workflow task such as author confirmation, review, or release

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the workflow task

attributes.name: assigned_to
attributes.description: The person or group responsible for completing the task

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: A translated version of a released document in a different language.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: The language of this document version

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The current state of the translated version in its approval process

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: A role-specific view displaying documents and information relevant to the logged-in user.

attributes.name: dashboard_type
attributes.description: The type of dashboard such as Reader Dashboard or Author Dashboard

objs.name: report
objs.description: An evaluation report providing filtered information about documents based on selected parameters.

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: The category of report such as Status Report or Search Report

objs.name: client
objs.description: In a multi-client system, a separate organizational instance for which document visibility can be controlled.

attributes.name: client_id
attributes.description: The identifier for the client instance

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: A designated user group that retains read access to archived documents while others lose authorization.

attributes.name: group_name
attributes.description: The identifier for the archive group

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: The action of creating a new document object in the system, establishing it with a document type and optionally a template.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The action of modifying the substantive content of a document using an editing client or Office component.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: The action of modifying metadata and attributes of a document such as title, references, or validity period.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: The action of attaching an external file or document to a document object in the system.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: The system action of automatically converting a document to PDF format after content is saved.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: The action of making a document visible to authorized readers after it has been released.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: The action of creating a controlled document supplement that will be released with the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: The action of marking an attachment as archived, which triggers a new version of the main document upon the next release.

evts.name: create_additional_information
evts.description: The action of creating a document supplement that is not subject to the main document's release cycle.

evts.name: delete_additional_information
evts.description: The action of removing additional information from a document without triggering version changes.

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: The action of a participant applying an electronic signature to confirm their role in the approval workflow.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: The action of a reviewer examining document content and attributes according to technical and formal criteria.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: The action of a releaser approving the final document for publication and distribution to readers.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: The action of proposing a modification to an existing document without affecting its current version.

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: The action of incorporating an approved change proposal into a document, triggering a new version.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The action of finalizing the editing and implementation of a change proposal.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The action of confirming that a document remains valid and updating its validity expiration date.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: The system action of generating a validity extension request when a document reaches 30 days before expiration.

evts.name: override_document
evts.description: The action of invalidating a document that has no additional validity and removing it from active circulation.

attributes.name: request_type
attributes.description: The type of override process being executed

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: The action of initiating a process to invalidate a document and archive it.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: The action of re-validating a previously invalidated document and restoring its active status.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: The action of initiating a request to restore an archived and invalidated document.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: The action of withdrawing a document from active circulation and revoking user authorizations.

evts.name: add_distribution_list_entry
evts.description: The action of assigning a user or user group to receive document release notifications.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: The action of notifying assigned users by email when a document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: The action of requesting users on the distribution list to actively confirm receipt and review of a document.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: The action of a user confirming that they have received and reviewed a document.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: The action of granting read or write permissions to a user or user group for a document.

evts.name: assign_reviewer_role
evts.description: The action of designating a user to perform technical and formal review of a document.

evts.name: assign_releaser_role
evts.description: The action of designating a user to approve and release a document for publication.

evts.name: assign_author_role
evts.description: The action of designating a user as the creator or primary modifier of a document.

evts.name: assign_co_author_role
evts.description: The action of granting additional change rights to a user alongside the primary author.

evts.name: assign_reader_role
evts.description: The action of granting read-only access to a user for viewing approved documents.

evts.name: assign_translator_role
evts.description: The action of designating a user to translate released document content into another language.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: The action of creating a language-dependent version of a released document.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The action of approving and finalizing a translated version for visibility to readers in that language.

evts.name: create_version
evts.description: The system action of automatically generating a new version when content or critical attributes change.

evts.name: view_document
evts.description: The action of a reader accessing and reviewing a released document.

evts.name: generate_report
evts.description: The action of creating an evaluation report that filters documents based on selected criteria.

evts.name: access_dashboard
evts.description: The action of a user viewing their role-specific dashboard displaying relevant documents and tasks.

evts.name: generate_audit_trail
evts.description: The system action of documenting all actions and changes to a document for traceability purposes.

evts.name: apply_tag_technology
evts.description: The system action of automatically inserting document metadata such as version and status into document content.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: The action of the system informing workflow participants of task status and workflow progress.

evts.name: restrict_client_visibility
evts.description: The action of specifying which client instances can see a particular document in a multi-client system.

o2o.description: A document can reference another document or be linked to other documents
A document can have attachments that are controlled and released with it
A document can have additional information supplements
A change proposal belongs to and is displayed in a document
A distribution list is maintained for each document
A document can have translated versions in other languages
A validity extension request is linked to the document being validated
An override request targets a specific document for invalidation
A reactivation request specifies which archived document to restore
A user group contains multiple users as members
A distribution list can include user groups
A distribution list can include individual users
A workflow task is assigned to a user for completion
A workflow task can be assigned to a user group
A document can be configured for visibility in specific clients
